description: Generate a CMX 3600 EDL for one video or audio track of a sequence from Premiere timeline readback (cuts, reels, source/record timecode, M2 lines for retimed clips), self-validate it, and return it inline or write it inside an approved workspace. Premiere is only read; this is not a Premiere-native export.

approved_workspace_path.description: Absolute existing directory that must contain output_path. Required with output_path.

drop_frame.description: Write drop-frame timecode (29.97/59.94 only). Defaults to the sequence display format.

frame_rate.description: Override the CMX timecode rate; defaults to the sequence rate (23.976 is written as 24).

include_clip_name_comments.description: Emit '* FROM CLIP NAME:' comments (default true).

include_disabled.description: Include disabled clips as events (default false).

output_path.description: Optional absolute .edl path to write. Requires approved_workspace_path; the file must not already exist. When omitted the EDL text is returned inline.

record_start_seconds.description: Record timecode origin in seconds (default: the sequence zero point).

reel_mode.description: How reel names are derived: clip_name (default), tape_name (XMP tapeName when present), or numbered.

sequence_id.description: Sequence ID or name. Defaults to the active sequence.

name: export_sequence_edl

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Export Sequence Edl
